Hi Elena,

Thanks for moving quickly on the onboarding items. We can proceed to issue the PO once we have an updated Certificate of Insurance (COI) that includes the following:

- Redwood Inference (Redwood Inference, Inc.) listed as Additional Insured on the General Liability and Auto policies
- Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference where permitted by law
- Primary and Non-Contributory wording for GL policy
- Policy dates that cover the full term of the initial purchase order (expected start 2027-06-01)

Per procurement policy we also need a copy of the vendor W-9 (we can accept the one you previously sent if nothing changed). If you can confirm estimated timing to deliver an endorsement or revised COI that reflects the bullet points above, we will provisionally queue the PO for signature.

If there are any blockers from your carrier (for example, a subcontractor exclusion or carrier limit), please call that out — we can discuss conditional PO language if needed, but we prefer to avoid exceptions to the additional insured request.

Thanks — next action: updated COI or endorsement PDF sent to procurement@redwoodinference.com and me.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Elena — quick follow-up and options so we can avoid a hold on activation: 

1) Ideal path: carrier issues the endorsement adding Redwood as Additional Insured + Primary & Non-Contributory + waiver of subrogation (where allowed). We will then finalize and send the PO within 1 business day of receipt.

2) Conditional path: if the endorsement will take longer than 10 business days, Redwood can issue a conditional PO that includes a clause requiring the vendor to deliver the executed endorsement within 21 days of PO effective date. If the endorsement is not delivered within that window, payments will be paused and Redwood reserves the right to terminate the PO.

3) If the carrier refuses to provide AI endorsement due to the subcontractor exclusion, please confirm whether the exclusion applies specifically to certain subcontracted activities or is blanket across the policy. If it is limited in scope we may accept a tailored conditional tolerance.

Please send the endorsement PDF or broker confirmation as soon as available. For our records, also include the broker contact and claim administrator info in that reply.

For finance routing, Logan — I routed a draft PO to your queue (PO-2027-045). Please advise if any additional procurement terms are required.

Best,
Kimberly
